Sophie: Quick question — my corporate card declined on a Eurostar ticket yesterday after a delay, so I bought a replacement ticket on my personal card. Do I submit this as a reimbursement or should I ask Travel to move the charge to the corpcard? I have the PDF receipt and delay confirmation from the train operator.

Tom (Finance): Sorry that happened — you can file as a reimbursement. Attach the PDF + the delay email. We’ll do a manual review and mark as an approved exception if manager sign-off is present.

Sophie: Thanks. Do I need manager approval before submitting, or can I submit and tag for approval after?

Laura: You can submit now and tag me. For policy: if corpcard declined, personal pay for critical travel is allowed with retro approval. We just need the confirmation that the original booking failed + a short note.

Sophie: Filing now — uploading receipts. Receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2000012345-eurostar.pdf Delay note: attached.

Tom (Finance): Got it. When you submit, select expense type = "Travel - Transport" and payment method = "Personal Card". Put notes: "Corp card soft-decline; repurchase due to delay; manager Laura approved."

Mike: Quick FYI — if VAT reclaim is applicable for EU rail fares, we generally don't reclaim (most rail is non-reclaimable). Finance will check headers but expect no VAT refund.

Sophie: Understood. Anything else I should include?

Laura: Include the corpcard soft-decline screenshot if you have it (helps ops with vendor). Also mention original booking ID.

Sophie: Added booking ID + screenshot. Submitted expense request: EXP-3829. Tagging @Tom (Finance) and @Laura for approval.

ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-3829 received and queued for approval. Estimated processing time: 3 business days.

Tom (Finance): Reviewing now — approved. We'll reimburse to your next payroll run unless you select direct bank transfer in the form. :thumbsup:

Sophie: Awesome, thank you both!

Mike: One more note for travel ops: travel team, can we confirm if vendor accepted corpcard after the soft-decline? If so let's get card limits tuned. @laura

Laura: I'll follow up with travel ops.

Sophie: Closing this thread — thanks everyone.
